verdict_reasoning.gates: All 13 gates in section 19 are met, and every pre-registered defect is closed. The verdict does not turn on them.
verdict_reasoning.the_blocker: The sprint's own closing invariant is that the MI Agent cannot silently answer an easier question than the one the client actually asked. It measurably can. An attributive qualifier no governed field claims is dropped without a word and the whole book is returned as the answer.
verdict_reasoning.why_this_is_not_a_probe_artefact: Measured on seven questions written in the vocabulary a real client would use — platinum, retirement interest only, enhanced, tier 1, prime, legacy — six are answered '640 loans / GBP 172.1MM' with ok=true and no mention that the qualifier was ignored; the seventh returns the whole-book ranking from the movement route. This is the most common shape a first real-data session will produce, because a real tape's vocabulary is largely ungoverned until it is mapped.
verdict_reasoning.severity: It is a WRONG ANSWER delivered with confidence — first in the stated priority order, ahead of misleading answers and embarrassing refusals. The synthetic banks do not show it because they ask in the vocabulary the book already carries.
verdict_reasoning.why_it_was_not_fixed_in_this_sprint: A generic fix was implemented and MEASURED to break three questions that work today, and was reverted rather than narrowed until it passed. Closing it needs the residue checked against the scope owner, the dimension owner and the grouping markers — a recognition change wider than this sprint authorised, whose own failure mode is refusing questions that work.
verdict_reasoning.what_would_clear_it: One bounded piece of work: make the attributive form agree with the prepositional form, which already refuses correctly. The two shapes of one question must not disagree. It should be done and measured on its own, with the three questions above as its regression set.
verdict_reasoning.not_optimised_for_a_verdict: A green verdict was available: section 10 authorised documenting this as a residual, section 19's gates are all met, and the probe now sits in a bank that contributes no passing grade. Reporting READY on that basis would be a verdict produced by moving a failure out of the denominator.
